placeholder.bookings: Your bookings will show up here once you connect your Cal.diy server.
placeholder.eventTypes: Your event types will show up here.
placeholder.availability: Your schedules and working hours will show up here.
placeholder.settings: Server, account and notification settings will live here.

server.title: Connect your server
server.description: Janji works with your own Cal.diy server. Enter the address you open in your browser to use Cal.diy.
server.apiAddressHint: Only needed if your server runs Cal API v2 at a different address, for example https://api.example.com/v2.

errors.invalid: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like book.example.com.
errors.insecure: Janji only connects over a secure connection. Use an address that starts with https://.
errors.api_address_invalid: That doesn't look like a web address. Try something like https://api.example.com/v2.
errors.not_cal_api: The server answered, but Cal API v2 isn't available there. Cal API v2 runs as a separate service next to Cal.diy, so it may not be set up on this server yet.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach that server. Check the address and your internet connection.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.

apiKey.title: Add an API key
apiKey.description: Janji signs in to {{server}} with an API key from your Cal.diy account. The key stays on this device.
apiKey.stepOpen: 1. Open the API keys page and sign in to Cal.diy if it asks.
apiKey.stepCreate: 2. Create a key named “Janji” and choose “Never expires”, so you won't have to do this again. You can delete the key there at any time.
apiKey.stepPaste: 3. Copy the key, come back here and paste it below.
apiKey.pasteHint: Pastes the key from your clipboard

errors.unauthorized: That key didn't work. Check that you copied all of it and that it hasn't expired or been deleted.
errors.rate_limited_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rate_limited_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rate_limited_unknown: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.not_cal_api: The server stopped answering as Cal API v2. Go back and check the server address.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.server_error: The server ran into a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.save_failed: Couldn't save the key on this device. Try again.
